{{Quote|My name is Hedarr Soongh. Long ago, I was a Great Hunt champion. I wish to see the integrity of the Great Hunt and our traditions preserved.|Hedarr Soongh|<ref name="TOR:HR" />}}
'''Hedarr Soongh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who earned fame among his people for being the youngest competitor to win the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] in [[3708 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Soongh was the youngest bounty hunter ever to win the Great Hunt. But that was over sixty-five years ago. He had an amazing career. Most of the crazy hunter stories out there are attributed to him. He's what bounty hunting is all about!|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:HR" />}}
[[File:Hedarr_Soongh_and_Sedyn_Kyne.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Hedarr Soongh confronts Sedyn Kyne.]]
Soongh was the youngest hunter to have ever won the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] before becoming a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Soongh became aware that a few of his failed pupils had joined forces with [[Tarro Blood]] to eliminate the competition. To that end, Soongh contacted Blood's nemesis, a talented and surviving [[Hunter (individual)|hunter]] to warn of Blood's associates gathering on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to plot the Hunter's final demise. Soongh personally supervised an [[Taung blood duel|honorable death match]] between the Hunter and the murderer of both [[Braden]] and [[Jory]]. However, though the Hunter prevailed, the other Mandalorians refused to heed Soongh's order to allow the Hunter to continue the Great Hunt in peace and shot him in the chest. Once the Hunter had dispatched them all, Soongh pleaded the Hunter to ensure that the Mandalorians would not lose their honor.<ref name="TOR:HR" />
